ModMetaData.name: RimLazy · Colony Work Planner
ModMetaData.author: RimLazy
ModMetaData.description:
殖民地自动分工。内置细分岗位和可调的工作优先级，默认六档。在「工作」页可手动调整，打开「分工」可按人员能力、工作条件和殖民地战略预览、应用或撤销整张工作表。
Split colony jobs into specialties and set up to 99 work priority levels. Open the Planner tab to assign workers by aptitude and colony goals, preview changes, apply them or undo.
